header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes with every timeout
counted: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile once the page has its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list
behind the launcher, and says when it is done; Firefox builds none there, and says so as the launcher comes up; it is
waited for 60 s at most), Start Game and the logos. Then two places in one load, each started by
tools/shader_survey.js's surveyWarp as the game's own map select does, with the debug save (every item and mask) on
the first morning, and each checked before it is played: a need that fails the run unless the play state's scene
(surveyScene()) is the one asked for. Link's health is kept full the whole time. Termina Field outside Clock Town's
south gate: Link runs out into the field and then about 30 s about there, walking to and fro, turning, swinging the
sword and targeting, clear of the gate, which takes him back into town. Then Woodfall Temple's entrance room as human
Link, about 30 s: Link sways out and back about where he arrived with Z held, so he steps without turning (forward and
back, to each side and back), then swings B, targets with Z and holds R. From the first warp on, its waits and holds
are on the game's own clock, the play state's gameplayFrames (20 a second, through sCamPlayState; each new play state
starts it at 0, which the wait after a warp counts from), so every browser walks Link as far whatever frames it gives
the game; each place ends by reading where Link is (the player actor's world.pos). A picture of Termina Field is taken
8 s in and of Woodfall Temple 6 s in. tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to two more places, for when a longer play
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|the game waiting for the \d+ of section
play: (() => { window.sceneIs = async (id, name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) { if (surveyScene() === id) return name + ', scene 0x' + id.toString(16); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('scene 0x' + surveyScene().toString(16) + ' plays, not ' + name + ' (0x' + id.toString(16) + ')'); }; window.keepAlive = window.keepAlive || setInterval(() => n64w(0x801EF6A4, (0x140 << 16) | 0x140), 250); return 'sceneIs, keepAlive'; })()
